task.title: Enregistrer les HA et production deferred boundaries
task.shortdesc: Indiquez quelles capabilities production, HA, reverse-proxy, restore et service-management sont absentes aujourd’hui et ce qui peut être préparé pour le design work futur.

prereq.p: Des notes readiness, network exposure, backup/export, monitoring et update-window existent pour l’instance source-run actuelle.

context.p: Ce topic trace la frontière entre current single-node source operation et future production architecture. Il indique explicitement what is planned but not implemented yet.

info.p: Écrivez que la documentation BPM 0.9.0 Administrator/DevOps prend en charge source deployment, manual configuration, health/readiness checks, API examples, manual backup evidence, documentation rebuild checks et single-node update windows.

step.cmd: Nommez les service et proxy capabilities absentes.

info.p: Listez packaged services, native Linux service units, Windows services, official reverse-proxy recipes, TLS/proxy recipes, managed secrets, authentication gateway configuration et production hardening comme absents de la BPM 0.9.0 source documentation.

step.cmd: Nommez les HA et upgrade capabilities absentes.

info.p: Listez supported HA clustering, multi-node coordination, load balancer session affinity guidance, shared storage locking, zero-downtime migration, rolling upgrades, automatic failover et official restore automation comme future work, pas comme current behavior.

step.cmd: Transformez les future needs en design inputs.

info.note: Ne placez pas plusieurs source nodes derrière un load balancer en appelant cela supported HA. Capturez required RTO/RPO, backup verification, TLS ownership, secrets ownership, logging, monitoring et upgrade-window expectations comme inputs pour les futures distribution/runtime tasks.

result.p: Le boundary record empêche les unsupported production, HA et reverse-proxy claims tout en conservant la preparation work utile pour future releases.

postreq.p: Utilisez ce record pendant la manual documentation QA et lorsque de futurs installer, service, reverse-proxy et HA backlog items seront approuvés.
